cohort: 3,209 patients who underwent cesarean sections out of 6,280 deliveries at the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology at RIMS, Ranchi, between March 2021 and August 2022.
finding: The maternal mortality ratio following cesarean section was 0.65% (338 per 100,000 live births).
followup_time: 24 hours post-operation (for the majority of deaths)
